import subprocess, os, shlex, hashlib, time
proof=root/'.ufo/waves/round-13/evidence'
proof.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def run_record(name,args,expected=None,stdin=None,extra_env=None,timeout=300):
    start=time.time()
    cp=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,input=stdin,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout,env=dict(os.environ,**(extra_env or {})))
    record='command: '+shlex.join(map(str,args))+'\ncwd: '+str(root)+'\n'+('environment: '+json.dumps(extra_env)+'\n' if extra_env else '')+'stdout:\n'+cp.stdout+'\nstderr:\n'+cp.stderr+f'\nexit={cp.returncode}\nelapsed_seconds={time.time()-start:.3f}\n'
    (proof/(name+'.txt')).write_text(record)
    print(name,'exit',cp.returncode,'expected',expected)
    if expected is not None and cp.returncode!=expected:
        print(cp.stdout[-3000:],cp.stderr[-1000:])
    return cp
